Every dataset uses same instrumentation; no total-minus-SQL Python attribution. If SQL exceeds half of end-to-end in a dataset, run separate EXPLAIN ANALYZE BUFFERS on relevant isolated synthetic SELECTs; otherwise do not invent SQL dominance. No backend changes before reviewed checkpoint. Prior profiles lack these new metrics.

not_measured: pure serialization separate from HTML render
pure materialization CPU independent of nested SQL/fetch/conversion
metrics.normalization: Strip comments; replace quoted/dollar SQL literals and numeric constants; collapse variable-length bind lists; collapse whitespace. Parameters never persisted. calls/total_time/mean_time all synchronous cursor.execute calls, seconds; patterns ordered by accumulated client execute time.

resources.request_topology: Django Client single request/PG synthetic isolated
resources.cache_state: fresh per-case seeded data, same process and shared PG/OS caches not reset;100 then1000 then10000; DummyCache

metrics.limits: End-to-end DjangoClient.get includes middleware/view/render; excludes fixtures/network/Gunicorn. cursor.execute includes driver/server IO/buffering and excludes later ORM iteration conversion/hydration. Model.from_db measures construction/state setup, includes post_init counter overhead; excludes SQL and earlier JSON conversion. ORM iteration intervals include lazy SQL/fetch/conversion/from_db; prefetch includes nested SQL/iteration and relation-cache mapping; context/validation/render include nested events. Timers overlap and cannot be summed as exclusive phases. Model instances/root objects/relation references are not SQL rows or distinct entities. Every dataset uses same instrumentation; no total-minus-SQL Python attribution. If SQL exceeds half of end-to-end in a dataset, run separate EXPLAIN ANALYZE BUFFERS on relevant isolated synthetic SELECTs; otherwise do not invent SQL dominance. No backend changes before reviewed checkpoint. Prior profiles lack these new metrics.

metrics.thread_cpu_scope: time.thread_time: CPU user+system of this synchronous DjangoClient request thread only; excludes PostgreSQL/other processes and other threads, does not measure DB CPU or concurrent capacity. Direct-child CPU intervals subtracted once, independent of wall-clock subtraction; includes profiler overhead. Paired control/profiler CPU and wall observed, causal overhead not_measured; no retroactive CPU attribution to prior profiles.
metrics.overhead: Paired route without/with selected wrappers, sequential control then profile, one sample each. Difference includes instrumentation and uncontrolled PG/OS cache effects: causal overhead not_measured; no correction applied.
metrics.scope: Synchronous request only; ContextVar nested stack; subtract direct instrumented child inclusive intervals once, never grandchildren again. Added prefetch by relation, manager construction/_apply_rel_filters and Model.from_db by model; earlier profile did not have these children and exclusive times are not directly comparable. from_db includes construction/state but not prior fetch/JSON conversion. exclusive_time is relative to observed children, includes uninstrumented Python/ORM work. Inline authorization/document/revocation conditions are included in validate_submission, not separately attributed. No arguments/parameters persisted; seconds, optional p95 not_measured. SQL execute may be nested inside forms/render/context; no total-minus-SQL validation attribution. publicly_visible imported alias in discovery is not separately observed; no missing event inferred as zero.
metrics.not_measured: rows_returned/affected/scanned; CPU/RSS/waits/locks/IO; independent inline predicate timings; causal profiler overhead; concurrent capacity; p95 exclusive

limits: Same matrix and CPU-profile instrumentation as respective previous evidence. Independent sequential samples, PG/OS caches unreset and shared host. CPU is request thread only; profiled second request retains control response/context. No DB CPU/GC/causal overhead/SQL rows/concurrent capacity attribution.
